summary: The operator is the Village of Eastlake (175 South Main St., 231-723-9558, per the Manistee County officials directory), which has no website; the only village-authored page is a Networks Northwest post from about 2013 ($23 electric / $15 non-electric, May 26 - Oct 26, 38 sites, showers and flush toilets), too old to price or date the entry. The Pure Michigan listing (phone 231-723-9558, 230 Gillispie Road) gives 37 sites (10 electric) and the dump station; both kept, now marked reported. No 2024+ rate, season, booking method or amperage from any official source, so fees, season, booking and hookups stay empty. Google Maps: 'Penny Park', 4.4 stars from 53 reviews, no phone or website of its own. Note left as is.
flags: Missing website: the Village of Eastlake has no website (the county's officials directory lists only an address, phone, fax and a gmail address); the entry links only the Pure Michigan tourism listing, which is the best page available.
Phone: the entry has none. The Village of Eastlake office is 231-723-9558 (Manistee County Local Government Officials directory; the same number on the Pure Michigan listing).

No 2024+ rate from the operator: the village's only posted rates ($23 electric, $15 non-electric) date from about 2013. A phone call to the village is the only way to confirm a current price and season.
